name: Mordred
source:
"I, Mordred, shall right the wrongdoing of the one who has disrupted the public morality."

Based on Sir Mordred, who is a character in the Arthurian legend, known as a notorious traitor who fought King Arthur at the Battle of Camlann, where he was killed and Arthur fatally wounded. Tradition varies on his relationship to Arthur, but he is best known today as Arthur's illegitimate son by his half-sister Morgause.

A knight of the Round Table under [url=/c5147]Arthur's[/url] command. Mordred is a strict disciplinarian, always following the rules and her oders to the letter. She's always thrown around by [url=/c5191]Bors[/url] and [url=/c5180]Percival's[/url] nonchalance and carelessness, as well asd [url=/c5190]Bediviere's[/url] delusions, giving her no end of mental stress. She works hard even when no one is looking.
